questions.question: The prophet Habakkuk said God's eyes are too pure to look on evil. What did he then ask God?

answers.text: Why He is silent as the wicked swallow the righteous
Why He made the horses of the Chaldeans so swift
Why He chose a prophet from such a small town

questions.question: The prophet Habakkuk wanted to hear God's answer to his questions. Where did he station himself to watch?

answers.text: At his guard post on the ramparts
In the temple courts in Jerusalem
In a cave on Mount Horeb

questions.question: The LORD gave the prophet Habakkuk a vision that seemed slow to come. What did He tell Habakkuk to do?

answers.text: Wait for it because it will surely come
Write it again in bigger letters
Ask another prophet for a new one

questions.question: In the LORD's message to the prophet Habakkuk about the proud, how did He say the righteous will live?
